events.fact: To create custom OAuth credentials for Pipedrive, a developer must sign up for a developer sandbox account at developers.pipedrive.com, navigate to Developer Hub via Settings, and create a new Public App or Private App.

Public apps require registration in the Developer Hub, configuration of Basic info (App name, single OAuth callback URL) and OAuth & access scopes, and submission for formal Pipedrive Marketplace review before arbitrary users can connect.
Private apps are shared via a direct unlisted installation link, do not appear in the Marketplace, and do not require the app approval process.
Pipedrive officially states public app reviews take up to 21 business days, but community reports show real-world waiting times exceeding two months.
Pipedrive OAuth authorize endpoint is https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize and token endpoint is https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token.
Access tokens expire in 60 minutes (returned in expires_in), while refresh tokens expire in 60 days if unused, with their expiry resetting on each use.
